about_the_game:
A long time ago, King Kourin defeated Vladrouge Scarlet to avenge the death of Queen Marisa’s mother Mima. The Gensokyo Continent was soon under the rule of three kingdoms headed by a different queen. Although Kourin still retained Marisa’s hand in marriage, he wanted each queen’s child to have his blood and strength. He would go on to kickstart three new royal bloodlines by bringing a son and two daughters.

During the first decade of their lives, all three kingdoms lived in prosperity. But then, the wicked vampire sorceress Flandre Scarlet of the Gensokyo Socialite Order shattered that peace. By bringing yourself, your stepsisters, and your childhood friend together, Queen Marisa has ordered you to combine your skill and effort to defeat Flandre and the Order.

In case you’re curious about who’s participating in this adventure:

  • Kichou Kirisame, the Prince of the Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo. He’s a heroic warrior who can equip all weapons and armor.

  • Miho Fujiwara, Kichou’s childhood friend. She’s a samurai in training who is quick in movement.

  • Mirabel Yakumo, the Princess of the Democratic Kingdom of Gensokyo. She has a broad array of healing and defensive spells.

  • Towa Houraisan, the Princess of the People’s Kingdom of Gensokyo. She can easily bend destructive spells to her will.

This massive role-playing adventure features:

NOTE: Basic reading ability is required to fully enjoy this game.

  • Four playable characters (characters above) ranging from a fighter, thief, and two magicians.

  • Watch day turn to night according to your system’s time. Some monsters only come out at night.

  • Over 100 different pieces of gear to equip, as well as special skills and magic.

  • Dozens of never-before-seen monsters, including new variants of existing monsters and new species.
